content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] V5 and can connect my computer via USB to [article_no] units without any trouble. However, when attempting to connect to an [article_no] unit, the transfer starts but unexpectedly stops at around 6%. Is there a plugin available for download so that V5 can access older hardware versions? I’m planning to try upgrading to [product_name] V6x to see if that solves the problem. Thank you.

Hi [user_name], Have you checked this resource: [url] I suspect the device needs to be manually set to transfer mode before initiating the connection. It’s also possible the issue is with the USB/PC cable. Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you for your response. Since I can connect to newer units, the cable seems fine. I manually stop the unit and begin the transfer, but it still stops at 6%. No error messages appear; the transfer window simply closes without explanation.

analysis.insight_summary: The user has encountered issues when using [product_name] V5 to connect to an older [product_name] hardware unit. While connection and data transfer work with newer units, attempts to transfer data to the older unit fail at 6% completion, with the process terminating unexpectedly and no error notifications. This lack of feedback complicates troubleshooting, making the user wonder if additional plugins or software upgrades are needed for compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the software to maintain reliable backwards compatibility with older hardware and provide clear instructions or error messages if problems occur.
